content: Ngigac homacnedi Yesu balaibeibong
Inguc aime Yesu ye taon nga mac-alingka lolicke hikelu, Wapongte ngani-damongte Siduc Madicne mime yegengkeyeleme gawec. Aime mic-tengtengfocine 12,

ailu ngigac gocne alengkolec nga hucnginengkolec bamadicebawec, yenge yeholec momoc hikeibong. Aime ngigac yenge monengngineng Yesu nga mic-tengtengfocine baficebalu gaibong. Ngigac homacnedi inguc aiibong, yengelacni monic wacine Maria, wacine monic Magadalen, yelacni aleng 7 yebiyewec. Nga monic Yoana, ngaweine Kusa, ye Herodele moneng-damong, ailu monic wacine Susana.
Wasec wicke-wickele nangeng yowa
Aime ngic-ngigac yenge taon falewecsoc, iwacni Yesula welelu habu sugucne aibong, yedi nangeng yowa yanguc edocebawec,

content.text: “Wasec wicke-wicke ngic monicti huc-wasec wickenale bolewa hikewec. Hikelu wasec wickeme wasec gocnedi walu yefewa holebong ngic yengi feina edeibong. Ailu nango yengi kwesilu nowackeibong.
Nga gocnedi posa tolowa holeibong. Holelu wasec yogo kwac kwodubong himong misaine mikac aiwecte ululuwelu homaibong.
Nga wasec gocnedi kpinding kwelina holeibong. Holelu kwac kwodubong kpindingti sugulelu hole-homacebawec.
Nga wasec gocnedi himong guwecineholecka holelu kwacine kwodulu noine madicne aiibong. Monicte hucine yogo 100 aiibong.”

content: Inguc milu sugucnehac yanguc wackelu edocebawec,

content.text: “Monic ye hedeckolecti yowa yago aneng ngagedaic.”

content: Yesudi nangeng yowale fungine edocebawec
Mime mic-tengtengfocine yenge nangeng yowale fungine yogolec uwacnobong
yanguc edocebawec,

content.text: “Wapongte ngani-damongte ngage-ngage sangkeicne, yogo ngengi sugu ngageningte biyac ngeleicne.
‘Aimebac ngic-ngigac gocne yenge dongenginengti wiyac monic nganilu nalic mi ngani-motogaing.
Nga hedecnginengti yowa monic ngagelu, sifu nalic mi ngage-motogaing.’
Ilec ailu nangeng yowa edocebacaigabac.
“Nangeng yowale fungine yogo yanguc, wasec yogo Wapongte yowa.

Aime wasec yefewa holeibong, yogo gocne yenge yowaine ngagedaingte. Ngagebong Aleng Sugucnenginengti welelu yengi Sugucne ngagesingkelu wasecne mi ainingte yowa yogo kwelenginangkocni baickeyelecaigac.

Wasec posa tolowa holeibong, yogo ngic gocnedi Wapongte yowa ngagelu kwelenginang biyac beliyelu sebilelu badaingte. Ailu kwelenginang godocine monic mi baicnele, dameng kpisicnemac ngagesingkebong lokwesac dameng kwesime yenge wawedaingte.

Aime wasec kpindingka holeibong, yogo gocnedi Wapongte yowa ngagedaingte. Yenge socte gagale ngageboc, nga moneng-mafale lokwesacka galu himongte ngani-angac ailu gadaingte. Yogodi yowa hole-homacebame noinengineng madicne mi aidaingte.

Aime wasec himong guwecineholecka holeibong, yogodibac ngic gocne yenge Wapongte yowa ngagelu kwelenginang lolu yefe dondonne nga madicne balu gadaingte. Inguc bagacgu tatakic mikac noine bafuwadaingte.

content: Hifa kwendangkelu mi someckenoga

content.text: “Aime monicti hifa kwendangkelu hebecti hemackelu mi heluluckedaicte, me mac ngiye-ngiyeinele bagewa lome mi ngiyedaicte. Yogo miyac, ye ngiye-ngiyeina lome ngiyeme ngic-ngigac macka ofedaingte, yenge hifa angocine yogo nganiyackedaingte.
Aime wiyac sasawa sangke-sangke fagac, yogo yegengkedaingte. Nga wiyac ebecineholec fagac, yogo gacgu ngageyackedaingte. Yogo sangkeicne mi fagidaicte.

Aime monic ye ngage-ngage gocne facnogac, ye ngage-ngage hatacmac lacnodaicte. Nga monic ye ngage-ngage mi facnogac, yelacni ngage-ngage facnogac ingucne ngagesigac, yogo ewalidaicte. Ilec ailu ngenge yowa ngagegabiyeng, yogo ngagelu ngage-motolu gadabiyeng.”

content: Yesule nenggac gbafocine
Aime Yesule nenggac gbafocine yenge yela hikebong, ngic-ngigac homacnedi hedickeibongte ailu nalic mi nganiibong.
Inguc aibong gocne yengi Yesula yanguc mibong fewec, “Nenggac gbafocgone yenge kwesilu nganicguningte lobina domagaing.”
Mibong Yesudi yanguc miwec,

content.text: “Wapongte yowa ngagelu balaibecaigaing, yengi nenggac gbafocne aigaing.”

content: Dibong gbelong yeki Yesule yowa ngageiboc
Dameng monicka Yesu ye mic-tengtengfocine yengeholec gombawa felu yanguc edocebawec,

content.text: “Nongileng lifuc nebocina hikenang.”

content: Inguc mime iwa hikeebongka,
Yesu ye gung fame gbelong sugucne welelu misa lifucka wewec. Aime dibongti gomba kwelina haulu bamungkenogale aime yenge haunogale aiibong.

Aime mic-tengtengfocine yenge Yesula lelu yeuckelu yanguc miibong, “Sugucne, Sugucne, nongileng misawa haulu homanogale aigabeleng!”Yesudi gbelong nga misa yowa milu kpatalayetegac Mibong Yesudi fangkelu gbelong nga dibong ngelengkelu kpatalayetelu edocepame, gbelong miyac aime lifuc ye kalong kwelu fawec.
Fame mic-tengtengfocine yengele miwec,

content.text: “Ngenge ngage-ngagesingngineng mikac mecne.”

content: Aime mic-tengteng yenge hangocebame kwatackeibong. Ailu yengungtihac ngani-welec ailu miibong, “Ye oma ngic, aime ye gbelong nga dibong yowa edocepame yele yowa ngagegabiyec.”
Yesudi ngic monictacni aleng yebicebawec
Aime Yesu nga mic-tengtengfocine yenge lifuc falockelu Gerasa ngic-ngigac yengele himongka hikeibong.
Himong yogo Galili lifuc nebocina.

Hike sulumebong, Yesu ye gombawacni walu taon yogowacni ngic monic alengfocineholec bafuwawec. Ngic yogo ye dameng dalicne biyachac senggang galu macka aneng mi ngiyelu dongesiwa ngiye-fac ailu gawec.

Game dameng dalicne aicnome ngic yengi balu senti hige-moleine hefelu damongkebong ngiyelu, ye sen welockeme aleng wonongkolecti mengockelu himong kisiwa misaine mikacka hikelu gawec. Aime Yesudi ngic yelacni aleng yebiyeme ofelu hikenale sanangne edowec. Inguc edome ngic yedi Yesu nganilu dacineholec aukwelu Yesule emewa wafalu yanguc wackewec, “Yesu, Wapong Feicnetowale Madec, ga nala wenuc ainogale ngagegic? Na yowa milu wasicgugabac, ga doicka mi locnudamec!”
Aime Yesudi yanguc uwacnowec,

content.text: “Ga wacgone ma?”

content: Uwacnome miwec, “Na wacne Habutowa.” Aleng homacnedi yele kwelewa haulu gaibongte ailu yedi wacine inguc miwec.
Aime yenge Yesu dogbac ailu yanguc micnoibong, “Ga long sugucnebenang iwa salecnubang mi haunang!”
Mime himong iwa bec-habu sugucnedi fegengka sulukwelu gaibong. Gaebongka aleng yenge yebicebame becka hauningte Yesu dogbac aicnobong, yedi inguc ainingte ngageyelewec.
Ailu yenge yebicebame baickelu bec-habu yengela haubong bec yenge fegengkacni gasackelu lifucka haulu misa nolu homayackeibong.
Homabong bec-damong yenge aibaba fikewec, yogo nganilu hangoc hikelu taonka nga mac-gogocka hikelu pasi fikewec, yogolec siduc milu edocebaibong.

Edocebabong ngic-ngigac yenge yogo ngagelu aibaba fikewec, yogo nganiningte Yesula kwesiibong. Kwesilu ngic alengkolec gawec, ye nganibong, yedi ngage-motolu ngakpi-kpoluc holelu Yesule higewa ngiyewec. Inguc ngiyeme yenge nganilu hangocebawec.
Ailu ngic dongenginengti pasi fikeme nganiibong, yengi ngic alengfocineholec gawecti wenucka madickewec, siduc yogo ngic-ngigac edocebaibong.
Edocebabong Gerasa ngic-ngigac yengele himong filefocine sasawadi homacnebenang hangocebawec. Ilec ailu Yesu ye himong yogo hegilenale edoibong. Edobong Yesudi hefaliyelu hikenale gombawa feme
ngic aleng yebiyecnowec, yedi Yesuholec hikenale dogbac aicnolu edowec. Edome Yesudi salelu yanguc edowec,

content.text: “Ga macgona hefaliye hikelu Wapongti pasi sugucne aigelegac, yogo miyengka yegengkena.”

content: Inguc mime ngic ye hikelu Yesudi yela pasi sasawa bawec, yogo taonka ngic-ngigac sasawa milu edocebayackewec.
Yesudi ngigac yaeckang bamadicepawec
Yesu ye lifuc nebocinacni kwesiyemewa, ngic-ngigac yenge yele wangec gaibongte ailu ye hefoleibong.

Aime kpakpaduc macte damong monic, wacine Yairus, ye welewec. Ye aduine moniyang sugu, hifaine 12 aiyemewa homanogale aiwecte ailu ngic ye welelu Yesule higewa wafalu macina hikenogale dogbac aicnowec. Aicnome yenge hikeebongka, ngic-ngigac habu sugucnedi hewalingkelu feine feine hikeibong.
Aime ngigac monic ye sac-dale aicnome gaemewa hifa 12 biyachac aiwec. Inguc aimebac monicti ye bamadickenale yefe mi bafuwawec.
Ye habu yengele hewacka Yesule lobewa yefe lelu ngakpi daleinele muc susucine oiyawec. Oiyame iwahac sacine kelengkeme
Yesudi yanguc uwawec,

content.text: “Madi oiyacnugac?”

content: Mime yenge “mi ngagegabeleng” mibong Pitadi yanguc edowec, “Sugucne, ngic-ngigac homacnedi wabunggulu hedicgugaing!”
Mime Yesudi yanguc miwec,

content.text: “Monicti oiyacnume tapili monicta leme ngagegabac.”

content: Inguc mime ngigac ye biyac ngagewec, “Na bafuwacnugac hocne.” Inguc ngagelu sangke-sangke hikenogale aibibiyelu dengdengkeme welelu Yesule higewa wangiyewec. Ailu Yesu oiyawec, nga wenucka biyacbenang madickewec, yogo ngic-ngigac yengele haicka mime yegengkewec.
Miyackeme Yesudi yele yanguc miwec,

content.text: “Ngigac, ngage-ngagesinggonedi bamadicgugac. Ga kwele-mogungkolec hikenong!”

content: Aime Yesu ye yowa milu domaemewa kpakpaduc macte damong, yele mackacni ngic monicti yowa yanguc bawelewec, “Adugone biyac homagac, ga wewedu hatacmac umac mi lacnoc!”
Mibong Yesudi yogo ngagelu Yairus edolu yanguc miwec,

content.text: “Ga kwele-umac mi ngagenong! Ga ngage-ngagesingka sugu domaengka ye gagaine hatacmac kwesidaicte.”

content: Inguc milu macka lekwesilu monicti macka mi feningte kpatalayelewec. Kpatalayelelu Pita nga Yoane ailu Yakobos nga adu nenggac-mamackecine, yengi sugu feningte miwec.
Aime ngic-ngigac nebocine yenge adule hisonggong aibong Yesudi yanguc edocebawec,

content.text: “Ngenge hii hegilening. Adu ye mi homagac, ye gung fagac.”

content: Inguc mime yenge adu ye biyac homawec, inguc ngageibongte ailu gouwecnoibong.
Aime Yesudibac adule molewa balu wackelu miwec,

content.text: “Adu, ga fangkec!”

content: Inguc mime asuine hatacmac hefaliye weleme iwahac gboliyelu fangkelu ngiyeme, Yesudi nosing lacnoningte edocebawec.
Edocebame nenggac-mamackecine yeke kwatackelu ngani-angac aiiboc. Aime Yesudi ngic monic mi edonicte mimacepawec.
